note: 3.0 (stage4-design.md B-2a, review N1, decision L-1): restored from 2.4.2 and open to a device token. The staged UUID flow is a 2.x feature: the PC client sends the bytes here and the model only receives the UUID that the MCP files tool then takes. /api/files/uploads needs a remotePath and a target, so it cannot replace it. Origin: when present it must equal BRIDGE_ADMIN_ORIGIN; the body is read in full and the identity is checked again afterwards (ARTIFACT_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED) as in 2.4.2. The 2.4.2 text above is the record of the 2.x behaviour; in 3.0 the identity is the administrator token owner, a session owner or a device token, and errors are ProblemDetail (stage4-design.md B-7).

auth: unauthenticated or unauthorized requests are rejected before routing: 401 {error:'Unauthorized'} / 403 {error:'Forbidden'} / 409 {error:'Request refused, expired, busy or unavailable'} for an unparsable URL (protocol.mjs:121).
requestShape: any
responseShape: 404 {error:'Not found'} for an unmatched authorized /api path; any thrown error => 409 {error:'Request refused, expired, busy or unavailable'}; admission saturation => 503 {error, executionAttempted:false, requestSubmitted:false, retryAfterMs:1000}
